headline: Amagi Media Labs reports Q2 profit of ₹75 crore
hook: Amagi Media Labs swings to profit
summary: Amagi Media Labs reported a net profit of ₹75 crore for the second quarter. The company's EBITDA reached ₹64 crore, a significant turnaround from the ₹3 crore loss recorded in the same period last year. Shares of the company rose nearly 7% following the announcement of these financial results.
why_it_matters: Improved profitability signals stronger operational efficiency for the media tech firm.

headline: Amagi Media Labs publishes investor presentation
hook: Amagi Media Labs releases latest investor deck
summary: Amagi Media Labs has submitted its latest investor presentation to the NSE. The document provides insights into the company's current operational and financial standing. Such disclosures are standard practice for companies to maintain transparency with stakeholders and potential investors.
why_it_matters: Provides transparency on company performance for existing and potential shareholders.

headline: Amagi Media Labs reports Q2 FY27 revenue of Rs 476 crore and PAT of Rs 75 crore
hook: Record revenue and profit surge at Amagi
summary: Amagi Media Labs Limited announced its financial results for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, reporting a record quarterly revenue of Rs 476 crore, representing a 27 percent year-on-year growth. Adjusted EBITDA more than doubled to Rs 89 crore compared to the same period previously. Profit after tax (PAT) saw a sharp rise, reaching Rs 75 crore. These figures reflect strong operational performance for the media technology company.
why_it_matters: Strong quarterly earnings signal solid business growth for Amagi shareholders.

headline: Amagi Media Labs appoints Srividhya Srinivasan as Whole-time Director
hook: Leadership change at Amagi Media Labs
summary: Amagi Media Labs has appointed Srividhya Srinivasan as a Whole-time Director. The appointment is effective from November 5, 2026, for a five-year term. This move remains subject to approval from the company's shareholders.
why_it_matters: Routine board-level appointment with no immediate impact on retail investors.

headline: Amagi Media Labs appoints Dr. Bhaskar Ghosh as independent director
hook: New independent director joins Amagi board
summary: Amagi Media Labs has appointed Dr. Bhaskar Ghosh as an Additional Non-Executive Independent Director. The appointment is effective from November 5, 2026, for a three-year term. The move remains subject to approval by the company's shareholders.
why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with no immediate impact on retail investors.

headline: Amagi Media Labs releases financial results for period ending September 2026
hook: Amagi Media Labs reports September quarter results
summary: Amagi Media Labs Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the NSE. The filing provides the latest performance data for the company. Retail investors can access these figures through the exchange portal to evaluate the company's recent operational health.
why_it_matters: Review the latest earnings to assess company growth and valuation.

headline: Amagi Media Labs shares fall 3% following cyber extortion disclosure
hook: Cyber extortion attempt hits Amagi Media Labs
summary: Amagi Media Labs shares declined 3% on Thursday after the firm disclosed a cyber extortion attempt involving operational and network configuration data. The company stated that services remain unaffected and no material financial impact is expected currently. External cybersecurity experts and legal counsel have been hired to investigate the claim. Retail investors should monitor future disclosures for any escalation in data breach risks.
whats_next: Further updates from the company's cybersecurity investigation
why_it_matters: Data breach risks could impact operational stability and investor sentiment.
